text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to reduce the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Nash Drive, between Bunnell Crescent (west leg) and Bunnell Crescent (east leg), and on Bunnell Crescent, between Nash Drive (west leg) and Nash Drive (east leg). The implementation of a 40 km/h speed limit on these roadways is warranted and will be consistent with the adjacent streets. The reduced speed limit will promote reduced travel speeds and provide a safer environment for cyclists and pedestrians, which includes students destined to/from nearby schools.

North York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing 40 km/h speed limit on Nash Drive, between Roding Street and Bunnell Crescent (west leg), to operate between Roding Street and Bunnell Crescent (east leg). 2. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Bunnell Crescent, between Nash Drive (west leg) and Nash Drive (east leg).
